spec.kitLine: start of battle: Dmg to Parts ▲ 24.26%
spec.scope: Generic parts-damage stat (partsDamagePct) — applies to all hit types; engine-inert in v1 (partless scope-lock boss, and hit location never changes a damage value).
spec.durationSemantics: Wall-clock 15 sec, applied ONCE at t=0 ('Activates at the start of battle' = one-shot, not recurring).
spec.triggerIdentity: One-time battle-start application (passive-style apply at frame 0 with durationSec:15). NOT interval, NOT recurring.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Permanent passive (no 15s expiry), or merging it with skill2's identical line into one recurring interval block — inflates uptime of the stat and destroys the s1-vs-s2 trigger distinction.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Exactly ONE buffApply per ally with stat 'partsDamagePct', value 24.26, at frame 0, expiresFrame ≈ 900 (15s@60fps); zero re-applications of this block later in the run.
spec.inertness: Every unit's totals() identical with this line removed (partsDamagePct is inert on the partless boss). It must move ZERO damage.

spec.kitLine: on part destroy: ATK ▲ 3% caster, x5
spec.scope: ATK buff, flat add scaled off the SKILL USER's ATK — stat identity is casterAtkPct (3% of Rosanna's staticAtk resolved flat at apply), NOT atkPct of each holder.
spec.durationSemantics: 30 sec per application, stacks up to 5 — wall-clock, not rounds.
spec.triggerIdentity: Fires when an ally or self destroys an enemy's PART. No part-destruction event exists in the v1 engine (partless boss) — this trigger can NEVER fire. Belongs in `unmodeled`, not a block.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Grafting it onto a trigger that does fire (interval / hitCount / fullBurstEnter) 'to represent it', or encoding as atkPct — over-credits team ATK that cannot occur in v1. Second-order misread: atkPct instead of casterAtkPct if ever enacted.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: NO buffApply with stat 'casterAtkPct' sourced from Rosanna's skill1 anywhere in the event log; totals() bit-identical with the line absent.
spec.inertness: Everything — the line must move nothing in v1.

spec.scope: Same generic partsDamagePct stat as s1 line 1; engine-inert v1.
spec.triggerIdentity: ■ header has NO 'Activates when' clause → interval trigger at skill2's datamined CD, first fire t=CD (repo convention). ⚑ cadence: the CD is not in the kit prose — datamined skillCooldownsSec, an ALWAYS-⚑ field.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Passive/permanent buff, or collapsing it into skill1's battle-start copy (they are distinct blocks: s1 fires once at t=0, s2 recurs on CD).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Recurring buffApply stat 'partsDamagePct' value 24.26 at t=CD, 2·CD, … in addition to (not instead of) s1's single t=0 apply — i.e. ≥2 distinct application frames across a 60s run.
spec.inertness: Zero damage movement (partless boss); removal changes no totals().

spec.scope: DoT (kind 'dot'), flavor 'sustained', 70.4% of Rosanna's final ATK per tick. DoTs are never core-boosted; crit is default-OFF (no measured crit evidence for this unit).
spec.durationSemantics: 15 ticks: every 1 sec for 15 sec per instance. TRAP: with a repeating trigger whose CD < 15s the engine APPENDS instances and never dedups — a 15s duration on the interval trigger would overlap and multiply ticks. Faithful shape = continuous ~1 tick/sec coverage (one long instance, or durationSec clamped to the trigger CD).
spec.triggerIdentity: No activation clause → interval at skill2's datamined CD (⚑, shared with the parts line's ■-pair cadence question — note the two ■ blocks may carry separate CDs). First-fire phase per repo convention (t=CD).
spec.targetSet: Enemy nearest the crosshair → the single boss. Block authored with target 'enemy' (validator-required; engine resolves the implicit boss).
spec.nearestWrongModel: interval trigger + durationSec:15 with CD≈10s → overlapping DoT instances yield ~1.5–2 ticks/sec (taxonomy trap #5, the multiplying-DoT misread). Runner-up misreads: flatDamage instead of dot; crit:true ticks; core-eligible ticks.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: Count Rosanna's sustained-flavor damage events over a 60s window: ≈60 ticks (~1.0/sec steady-state), NEVER ≈2/sec; every tick non-core, and tick mult reflects 70.4% pre-bucket. GREEN under continuous single-instance, RED under overlapping-instances.
spec.inertness: Ticks take no core bucket, no charge bucket; tick cadence unaffected by her firing/reloads.

spec.scope: sustainedDamagePct — additive in the Damage Up bucket, boosts ONLY sustained-flavor damage (notably her own S2 DoT ticks, and any teammate sustained sources). NOT generic attackDamagePct.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast — a line in HER OWN burst block fires only on rotations SHE casts Burst II (cd 20s). NOT fullBurstEnter: with another Burst-II unit in the comp (e.g. crown in the control fixture) only one B2 casts per rotation, and the two triggers diverge exactly there.
spec.nearestWrongModel: Keyed to fullBurstEnter (fires on every team FB, including rotations the other B2 casts — over-credits), or encoded as attackDamagePct (boosts ALL damage, not sustained-only).
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply stat 'sustainedDamagePct' value 20.32 on all 5 units ONLY at frames where a burstCast event from Rosanna's slot occurs; her S2 DoT ticks inside the 10s window rise by the diluted Damage-Up factor while her own AR normal-shot damage events are unchanged by the buff. In a comp where the other B2 takes a rotation, that rotation shows NO application.
spec.inertness: Non-sustained damage (her AR shots, teammates' normals/bursts) must not move when this buff is present vs stripped.

spec.scope: Boss DEBUFF (damageTakenPct, its own multiplicative bucket) — multiplies the WHOLE TEAM's damage vs the boss for 10s. Taxonomy trap #4: this is not a self/ally buff and not diluted in Damage Up.
spec.triggerIdentity: burstCast (same block-identity as the sustained line — her own Burst II cast, cd 20s). NOT fullBurstEnter.
spec.targetSet: All enemies → the boss (boss-held debuff: buffApply emits casterIdx===null AND targetIdx===null; filter by stat+value, not by indices).
spec.nearestWrongModel: Modeled as an ally-side attackDamagePct buff (wrong bucket — gets diluted by other support Damage-Up instead of multiplying cleanly), or keyed to fullBurstEnter, or dropped as 'defensive/enemy-side, no damage'.
spec.distinguishingAssertion: buffApply stat 'damageTakenPct' value 32.23 with casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null exactly at Rosanna's burstCast frames; EVERY unit's damage events inside the 10s window scale ≈×1.3223 vs a withPatchedOverride run with the line deleted (team-wide, not Rosanna-only).
spec.inertness: No damageTaken factor outside the 10s windows; zero applications on rotations she does not burst.

loadBearingSet: skill1:parts-battle-start (damage-inert — assertions are event-level: single t=0 apply + zero board movement)
skill2:parts-interval (damage-inert — recurring applies distinct from s1's one-shot + zero board movement)

skill1: ■ Activates when an ally or self destroys an enemy's part. Affects all allies. / ATK ▲ 3% of the skill user's ATK, stacks up to 5 time(s) and lasts for 30 sec. — no destructible parts in v1; trigger can never fire

notes: Expected shared-prior misreads, in order of damage-at-stake: (1) burstCast vs fullBurstEnter on BOTH burst lines — Rosanna is Burst II; the default controlComp(carry) fixture slots the unit as the B3 CARRY, which is wrong for her. The driver's fixture must place her as the casting B2 (replace or coexist with crown deliberately) and must include a divergence check: a rotation where the OTHER B2 casts must show zero applications of her burst effects. fullBurstEnter would be silently green in a solo-B2 fixture — the test comp choice is itself load-bearing. (2) DoT multiplication — the 15s sustained DoT on a no-clause (interval) trigger: if skill2's datamined CD < 15s, encoding durationSec:15 on the repeating trigger makes the engine stack overlapping instances (~2 ticks/sec). Assert absolute tick cadence (~1/sec), not just per-tick magnitude. The skill CD itself is an ALWAYS-⚑ cadence field (not in prose). (3) Cross-line tandem INSIDE her own kit: the burst's sustainedDamagePct must lift her S2 DoT ticks during the 10s window and must NOT lift her AR shots — a single assertion kills both the attackDamagePct misread and a mis-flavored DoT simultaneously. (4) damageTakenPct is boss-held: buffApply carries null casterIdx/targetIdx — an index-based event filter finds nothing and a driver may wrongly conclude the line is unapplied; filter by stat+value. (5) The duplicated 'Damage to Parts ▲ 24.26%' in s1 and s2 must remain two distinct blocks (one-shot t=0 vs CD-recurring); both are damage-inert on the partless boss, so their assertions are event-presence + board-inertness, and per the finding-inertness rule that inertness claim should itself be asserted, not assumed. (6) The part-destruction ATK stack line is a GAP (no part events in v1) and belongs verbatim in `unmodeled` — grafting it onto any firing trigger is the misread; if it were ever enacted the stat is casterAtkPct (flat, 3% of HER staticAtk), not atkPct.
